ashley: quick heads-up: planning a 02:00 UTC quickwave (runtime+router+api). Need pins and a manual hold after canary.

ben: what's canary and region?

ashley: 5% EU -> hold 5m -> then 30% global. Prewarm routers T-15m.

mira: console schema still mid-mig. Pin console schema to v2.3 and disable schema writes during canary. I'll flip the FF.

ashley: pins: runtime->runtime-v5.1, api->api-2026-03-25-rc1, console->schema-v2.3. Disable model-quant for canary.

sre-ops: SRE checklist: prewarm routers, eviction_grace=30s, fast-failback to api-legacy. Rollback if error_rate >2x or p95 > 350ms for 5m.

ben: add rollback triggers to notes and runbook. Ill draft release notes.

mira: runbook: at T-5m `ffctl set console.schema_writes false`; on rollback `deploybot unpin && router rollback stable && ffctl set console.schema_writes true`.

deploybot: scheduled: quickwave-1799999001-02:00UTC. Steps: prewarm, pin, disable writes, canary 5% EU, hold 5m manual sign-off, ramp 30% global. Manual hold added.

sre-ops: dashboards created; alert: `p95_latency > 350ms for 5m OR error_rate_ratio > 2 for 3m`. Links posted.

ashley: owners for sign-off? mira: console+api, ashley: runtime+router, ben: metrics. Ready? :thumbsup:

ben: :thumbsup:

mira: :thumbsup:

sre-ops: :thumbsup:

ashley: final: if anything odd -> rollback-runbook-quick (unpin + route back).
